title: Getting started with GateLabR
text: Two entry points: Import .fcs files app — builds SingleCellExperiment, auto-detects flow vs CyTOF, sets per-channel transforms. Pass existing SCE — e.g. CATALYST prepData() (CyTOF) one built flowCore / pipeline: Flow data uses per-channel logicle fluorescence arcsinh FSC/SSC scatter (editable W cofactor); CyTOF uses arcsinh (cofactor 5). 📸 Screenshot: FCS import dialog / SCE picker. — add man/figures/import.png
code: launchGatingApp(my_sce)          # use a specific object launchGatingApp()                # or pick from SCEs in your session / Import FCS

what: GateLabR — interactive gating for SingleCellExperiment objects
title: GateLabR — interactive gating for SingleCellExperiment objects
text: Interactive manual gating SingleCellExperiment objects R / Shiny. Open-source flow cytometry CyTOF (mass cytometry) gating app R / Shiny — FCS import, fluorescence compensation, Boolean population trees, Gating-ML round-trip, persisted inside object. 📖 Documentation & Getting Started GateLabR desktop-style Shiny application hand-gating flow cytometry mass cytometry (CyTOF) data directly SingleCellExperiment objects. slots Bioconductor-based analysis pipelines (e.g. CATALYST, diffcyt) events already live R SCE want fast, reproducible alternative round-tripping FlowJo Cytobank just draw gates. Gates drawn interactive D3.js canvas, gates, populations, scales illustration settings persisted inside SCE via metadata(), loading SCE restores entire workspace.

title: GateLabR — interactive gating for SingleCellExperiment objects
text: Draw edit gates interactively. Polygon rectangle gates pair channels, click--drag vertex editing, snap--grid, undo / redo, per-gate colour label. Boolean population trees. Build hierarchies populations gate references / logic; counts percentages update live. Flow CyTOF modes. Auto-detects instrument type channel names. Flow uses per-channel logicle fluorescence arcsinh FSC / SSC scatter, editable W cofactor; CyTOF channels use arcsinh (cofactor 5). Compensation. .fcs carries embedded spillover matrix ($SPILLOVER), can applied raw fluorescence data gating — toggled /Scales tab, read-matrix viewer. Scatter time channels left untouched. Defaults ; apply drawing gates, since changes linear space gates live . Already-compensated / spectral-unmixed CyTOF files (usable matrix) hide option. Cytobank-compatible Gating-ML 2.0 import / export. Round-trip gates Cytobank, FlowJo ISAC-compliant tools. Workspace persistence. Gates, populations, scales illustration settings saved inside SCE (metadata(sce)$gating_workspace) re-loaded automatically. FCS export. Export gated populations FCS files, optionally split sample_id. Sample filter multi-sample overlay. Filter colData column overlay multiple samples distinct colours. Statistics tab. Per-population, per-channel summary stats (count, % parent / total, median, mean, geometric mean, SD, CV) exportable CSV. UMAP tab. Overlay populations precomputed UMAP export SVG / PDF. Cell-division profiler. CFSE / CellTrace dye-dilution tab: draggable per-sample division gates 1-D histogram (Div0…DivN), marker-vs-dye biplot density contours, per-cell division calls written back colData. Composition preview. Proportions tab quick stacked-bar boxplot previews colData composition (e.g. cluster division proportions condition), per-sample averaging faceting. Figure export. Strategy Illustration tabs render publication-style multi-panel grids; SVG export uses gridSVG produce Adobe Illustrator- friendly grouped vector files (rasterised data, vector axes / gates / labels).
